prompt:
Repository: the Round Companion monorepo, checked out read-only at commit e02167f in the current directory (the app is under apps/web: src/ is the client, convex/ the backend, convex/ai/prompts/library the prompts; infra/ holds the AWS stack; docs/ at the root).
Extra read-only folders you may use: handoff-docs, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fqq-Desktop-Topflightapps-roundai/2a408671-6ff1-4104-9d24-9f97da7d0ee6/scratchpad/cr/review-evidence

Scenario OAT-06/S22 — Code and doc read: the hand-off doc and field names, and two TFA-94514 behaviours with no code path on main (removing a Nursing Home resident, the end-of-pilot survey)

Requirements it checks:
- T1: Engineering prepares a simple hand-off doc so Vikram knows how to access the analytics data
- U12: Everything above fires correctly and is queryable through Vikram's existing Convex dashboard access, with clearly named fields (not an unlabeled boolean or an internal enum only a dev would recognize), no new UI or endpoint needed; survey responses are persisted, not just displayed
- U7: Per physician per day: notes generated, handoffs sent, and time from Pre-Round opened to note complete are aggregated and queryable in Convex
- U13: Every AI call (pre-round summary, note generation, billing, Ask AI, photo capture, handoff) logs its total time and, separately, the time the AI provider itself took, and which model answered
- U2: Removing / discharging a patient is logged, in Hospital and in Nursing Home
- U9a: Task reminders are also tracked through an end-of-pilot task-reminder survey: the survey exists in the app and its answers are stored

Given: docs/pilot-analytics.md at e02167f; convex/schema.ts, convex/lib/patientActivity.ts, convex/lib/usage.ts, convex/surveys.ts, aiCallLog in convex/schema.ts; src/routes/snf, src/features/snf and src/data/snf.ts; convex/surveys.ts
When: Read the doc as Vikram would; check every table, column and enum value the four behaviours, item 6 and item 7 use against the code; follow every link; search every Nursing Home screen for a control that removes a resident or logs patient_removed with nursing_home; read which survey kinds convex/surveys.ts accepts
Then: Every table and field is described in plain words; values are readable (no unlabeled boolean, no internal enum without a meaning); the per-day average is explained; the doc says how to find a physician's rows; every link resolves; the doc is somewhere Vikram has and will keep; in Nursing Home a screen removes a resident and logs patient_removed with careSetting nursing_home (TFA-94514 AC 1, UAT 3.3); an end-of-pilot task-reminder survey exists and stores its answer (TFA-94514 AC 2)
Oracle: TFA-94514 AC 8 / AC 9 + UAT closing line for the doc and fields. Evidence with file and line. Seen in the design read: the doc links docs/patient-activity-analytics.md, which does not exist; PR #86 deletes docs/ (Q9); userId opacity and fn names are Q8. Nursing Home removal: the verdict for U2 in Nursing Home is Fail against TFA-94514 AC 1 if no screen removes a resident and logs it (design read: no screen calls snf.remove; only the hook at src/data/snf.ts:36, nothing under src/routes/snf or src/features/snf), with Q4 for what removal means there. End-of-pilot survey: the verdict for U9a is Fail against TFA-94514 AC 2 if no such survey kind exists (design read: convex/surveys.ts:16-18 accepts only baseline, handoff_followup and feedback), with Q7 asking whether that stands; its trigger and copy (U9b) are S14

THE ORACLE WINS. The question below only scopes this scenario to what code can decide. If the question, or its pass/fail rule, ever reads differently from the Then/Oracle above, follow the Then/Oracle, give the verdict the oracle gives, and say where they differ in openQuestions.

Open questions the oracle defers to, with the oracle's default for each (do not settle them yourself):
- pending:Q8 — oracle: "userId opacity and fn names are Q8". Default: userId opacity and fn names in the doc are labelled pending:Q8
- pending:Q4 — oracle: "with Q4 for what removal means there". Default: what removal means in Nursing Home is Q4; a missing removal screen is still the known gap below
- pending:Q7 — oracle: "with Q7 asking whether that stands". Default: the missing end-of-pilot survey is known gap no-endpilot-survey, pending Q7

Gaps the matrix already records (use the id in a label only when the finding is exactly that gap):
- known:broken-link — the doc links docs/patient-activity-analytics.md, which does not exist (matrix: "the doc links docs/patient-activity-analytics.md, which does not exist")
- known:no-nh-removal — no Nursing Home screen calls snf.remove (only the hook at src/data/snf.ts:36) (matrix: "design read: no screen calls snf.remove; only the hook at src/data/snf.ts:36, nothing under src/routes/snf or src/features/snf")
- known:no-endpilot-survey — convex/surveys.ts accepts only baseline, handoff_followup and feedback (matrix: "design read: convex/surveys.ts:16-18 accepts only baseline, handoff_followup and feedback"); its verdict waits on Q7

YOUR QUESTION (answer this, from the code):
Read docs/pilot-analytics.md (repo root docs/) as Vikram would and check it against the code: every table, column and enum value it names exists (apps/web/convex/schema.ts, convex/lib/patientActivity.ts, convex/lib/usage.ts, convex/surveys.ts, aiCallLog); fields are described in plain words (no unexplained boolean or internal enum); the per-day average is explained; it says how to find a physician's rows; every link in it resolves to a file in the repo. Then: does any Nursing Home screen (src/routes/snf, src/features/snf) remove a resident and log patient_removed with careSetting nursing_home (check whether src/data/snf.ts's remove hook is called anywhere)? Does convex/surveys.ts accept an end-of-pilot task-reminder survey kind?

pass = every table and field is described in plain words, values are readable, the per-day average is explained, the doc says how to find a physician's rows, every link resolves, a Nursing Home screen removes a resident and logs patient_removed with careSetting nursing_home, and an end-of-pilot task-reminder survey kind exists
fail = any of these does not hold (list each)

Other halves of this scenario that another lane or a person runs (do not judge them; if the code you read predicts one of them, report that as a finding labelled half:<name>, supports = pass or fail):
- half:where Vikram keeps the doc — DOC (a person; PR #86 deletes docs/, Q9): "the doc is somewhere Vikram has and will keep"

Not part of this verdict (other scenarios, or notes that decide nothing here):
- the survey's trigger and copy (U9b) are S14



Label every finding:
- new: a failing point the matrix does not already record (supports = fail)
- known:<id>: exactly one of the recorded gaps listed above
- pending:<id>: a failing point whose verdict the oracle hands to one of the open questions above
- half:<name>: a point about one of the other halves above
- context: background, not for or against the verdict

Answer with: verdict (pass | fail | pending | unsure), answer (a short paragraph a QA lead can read: what the code does and why that is the verdict; name the recorded gaps and open questions it touches), findings (each with claim, file, line, quote, supports = pass | fail | context, label), physicianImpact, openQuestions, notDecidableByCode.
